messages.content: You look at one picture of a creature and answer numbered questions about it. Answer each question on its own: yes if the picture clearly shows it, no if it clearly does not, unclear if you cannot tell. Many questions describe things that should not be there, so do not lean toward yes. Judge only what is visible. answers: one word per question (yes, no or unclear), in the same order as the questions, nothing else. notes: one short sentence.

content.text:
Questions:
1. Is the overall body shape that of a brown bear?
2. Does it have a brown bear head with visible eyes?
3. Does it have european rhinoceros beetle wings in place of its front legs?
4. Does it stand on four walking legs and also have wings?
5. Is there european rhinoceros beetle jointed tail segments in place of the tail?
6. Is there a whole separate animal, or an animal-shaped object with its own head, legs or wing cases, attached to or sitting on the body?
7. Is there a second head anywhere?
8. Are there jointed, insect-like leg pieces on or along the legs?
9. Does it have more than 2 walking legs?
10. Are there long curved head horn anywhere on the creature?
11. Does it have a full mane of long hair around the head and neck?
12. Does the fur show stripes or spots?
13. Are there hard, glossy chitin plates with fine seams on the shoulders and neck?
14. Do the hard, glossy chitin plates with fine seams grow out of the body with a natural transition (for example fur stopping at a shield's edge, or skin blending into scales), rather than looking attached on top?
15. Do the hard, glossy chitin plates with fine seams look like separate pieces attached on top of the fur?
16. Do the hard, glossy chitin plates with fine seams form one continuous structure over the shoulders and neck, rather than scattered pieces?
17. Are the hard, glossy chitin plates with fine seams scattered as separate pieces over different parts of the body?
18. Are there hard, glossy chitin plates with fine seams on the legs?
